title: Proof of a conjecture of Banerjee,Bringmann and Bachraoui on infinite families of congruences
summary: Recently, Andrews and Bachraoui investigated congruences for certain restricted two-color partitions. They made two conjectures for Ramanujan type congruences and a vanishing identity for the limiting sequence. Very recently, Banerjee, Bringmann and Bachraoui confirmed these three conjectures by relating the corresponding generating function to modular forms and mock theta functions. At the end of their paper, they posed a conjecture on infinite families of congruences modulo 4 and 8 for the limiting sequence.
